4. The Skyjacked Shadow
On a stormy Thanksgiving Eve in 1971, a quiet man in a dark suit boarded a flight in Portland, ordered a bourbon, and handed a flight attendant a note claiming he had a bomb. After receiving $200,000 in cold cash and four parachutes in Seattle, he ordered the plane back into the air and leaped out of the rear staircase into a freezing wilderness. Only a small bundle of rotted cash found by a boy years later proves he was ever there at all. By what famous alias do we know this mystery jumper who literally walked into thin air?

5. The Fugitive Earl
In the dark hours of November 7th, 1974, a London nanny was brutally murdered in a basement, and a terrifying struggle left a noblewoman covered in blood. The prime suspect was her estranged husband, a high-stakes gambler who fled into the night and left his car abandoned at a coastal port. Though sightings of him have been reported from the jungles of Africa to the outback of Australia, the British aristocracy’s most famous fugitive was never seen again. What was the title of this infamous man, the 7th Earl of his name?
